blocks.label: 旧伤修复：原件先由她保管

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盘你先拿着。我把当时知道的都说清楚。
lines.en: Keep the drive with you. I'll tell you everything I knew then.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好，我拿着。你知道什么，从头说。
lines.en: I will. Tell me what you knew, from the beginning.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你把当时看出来的不对劲一件件说了。她一直听着，没有打断你。
lines.en: You go through each thing that struck you as wrong. She listens, her hand resting on the papers.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以后也照这样。不管盘在谁手里，都不许把我蒙在鼓里。
lines.en: Do the same from now on. Whoever holds the drive, I won't be kept in the dark.

blocks.label: 旧档和解：把经过和记录摊开

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先把那天的事说完。以后查到什么，记录都给你看。
lines.en: Let me tell you the rest of that day. From now on, you see the records of everything I find.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就从你什么时候看出不对开始说。别光挑你觉得我听了不会生气的说。
lines.en: Start with when you knew something was wrong. Don't just choose the parts you think won't upset me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你把那天的经过从头说了一遍。她没有替你打圆场，也没有把资料收走。
lines.en: You tell her what happened from the beginning. She doesn't make it easier for you, but she doesn't put the papers away either.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我会看着的。答应过的，你自己记住。
lines.en: I'll read them. Remember what you've promised.

blocks.label: 担心办不到：先谈能做的，不自动退出

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我现在没有更稳妥的门路。先说说眼下能做的。
lines.en: I don't have a safer way right now. Let's talk about what we can do.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 办不到的先说清楚，别拿没把握的话哄我。
lines.en: Tell me what you can't do. Don't comfort me with promises you can't keep.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 眼下能谈的，只有交盘换人。别的，我还没拿到准信。
lines.en: We can negotiate the drive for her release. I have no firm answer on anything else.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那就先谈这个。你说没把握，我听得懂。
lines.en: Then let's start there. I understand what it means when you say you aren't sure.

blocks.label: 侍从告白：温柔接住她的心意

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那就过来。以后想见我，不必先找差事。
lines.en: Then come here. You don't need an errand as an excuse to see me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 活我也照样会干。别一答应你，就把我的位置收走了。
lines.en: ...I'll still do the work. Don't take my place away the moment you say yes.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 位置给你留着。我也喜欢你，听清楚了？
lines.en: Your place stays yours. I love you too. Did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 听清楚了！你小点声。
lines.en: I heard. Keep your voice down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 你朝她伸出手。这回，她没再装作要去拿抹布。
lines.en: You hold out your hand. This time, she doesn't pretend to reach for the cloth.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 我也喜欢你。别再拿擦柜台作借口了。
lines.en: I love you too. Stop using the counter as an excuse.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……谁拿它当借口了！
lines.en: ...Who says it was an excuse?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 同一块地方，擦了三遍。
lines.en: The same patch. Three times.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你都数了，还非等我先说。
lines.en: You counted, and still waited for me to say it first.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那现在不等了。手给我。
lines.en: Then I won't wait now. Give me your hand.
